caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a light beige skin tone, dark hair styled in a tight updo, and rosy cheeks, with defined facial features including red lips. The doll is dressed in a floor-length, off-the-shoulder, light-colored gown, predominantly pale pink and white with subtle blue and gray shading to indicate folds and shadows. The dress features full, bell-shaped sleeves ending just above the doll’s wrists, and is cinched at the waist with a patterned sash that includes blue, red, and white colors. There is a pink ribbon tied into a bow at the back of the sash. The hem of the gown is trimmed with a blue line. The background of the drawing is plain and light, with no other objects present. The composition focuses solely on the doll, shown standing and in partial profile, with the head turned slightly to the viewer’s right.
title: Doll
